<div class="card-body">
'''Defel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊デフェル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">“夜間状態”において、1フォース消費して戦闘から“隠れる”ことができる（戦闘に参加しない）。「革命」の影響下にある位置では、自分の支配フェイズに敵が1フォースをロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Defel-PSA-160005371.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アフェル出身のデフェル男性。“霊体”のあだ名でも知られるこの種族は、周囲の光を屈折させ、暗がりに身を隠す能力を持っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Defel.

'''Card text:'''
Under “nighttime conditions,” you may use 1 Force to “hide” from a battle (does not participate). At a location affected by Revolution, opponent loses 1 Force during your control phase.

'''Lore:'''
A male Defel from Af'El. This species, also nicknamed “wraiths,” can bend the light around them and hide in the dark.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 霊体 for wraiths and 「革命」 for Revolution.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Defel]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
